name: Improved Back to Back [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
After much practice, you and an ally have become adept at fighting in close proximity to one another.

Prerequisite(s): Back to Back, Perception 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): While you are adjacent to an ally who is flanked, you can spend a swift action to grant your ally a +2 bonus to AC against all flankers until the start of your next turn.
